title: Vietnamese Cookies
description: A classic Vietnamese dessert, these cookies are crunchy on the outside and chewy on the inside. They're perfect for snacking or as a gift.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and salt.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, butter, and vanilla.
Add the flour mixture to the wet ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut into desired shapes using a cookie cutter.
Place on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until lightly golden.
Let cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
